messages.subject: Share data across sessions with ShinyApps.io
parts:
I didn’t get any feedeback to my comment posted on the article http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/share-data.html.

I’ve just realized that if we deploy the original example (https://gist.github.com/trestletech/3679b34c5a83f521387b) the log.txt file is correctly updated and preserved across sessions…as explained in the article we get troubles ONLY when redeploying. I’m then wondering whether we can download the last version of the data file (log.txt) from the server and simply deploying again making the suggested solutions unnecessary…we would simply need a way to get selected data files from ShinyApps.io server. Am I oversimplifying things?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Share data across sessions with ShinyApps.io
parts:
This approach won't work; log.txt will not be preserved even between redeploys. Once your app goes idle (i.e. no users are connected) ShinyApps may decide at any time to shut it down until the next user shows up, and when that happens any changes you made on disk will be lost. Even if we didn't do that, your app may be deployed on multiple different servers, the copy of log.txt you download would depend on which server you happened to hit at that exact moment.

I do think we need to offer a solution to this problem that's easier than the ones we have today, but at the moment the ones in the article you linked to are what you need to do.
